premises.text: Commoditized brains/sensors/software leave hardware—especially actuators—as the costly bottleneck (e.g., humanoid manufacturing cost)
premises.evidence_span: most of that comes from complex actuators and hardware

premises.text: Three recreatable building blocks—servo, joint, link—let users build many robot forms and disassemble to rebuild
premises.evidence_span: They're versatile, so you can use them to build a robot arm, a 3D printer, or even a humanoid robot

premises.text: Tightly integrated servo joint embeds motor driver, networking, and mechanical interfaces to cut cost and weight
premises.evidence_span: combine all of that into one little unit, which is tightly, tightly integrated

premises.text: Phone app plus VR/cloud builder with physics engine support rapid programming, sharing, and ordering
premises.evidence_span: You can assemble and program your robot on the fly, inside of the browser, and test and simulate in a real physics engine

value.text: Make building robots accessible and thrilling for inventors outside research labs
value.evidence_span: that's basically what we want to make really accessible with ModBot
